name: riffquest

scripts.scripts:list: node -e 'import fs from "fs"; const pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("./package.json")); const descs = pkg.scriptsDescriptions || {}; const maxName = Math.max(...Object.keys(pkg.scripts).map(k=>k.length)); const maxDesc = Math.max(...Object.keys(pkg.scripts).map(k=>descs[k]?.length||0)); Object.keys(pkg.scripts).forEach(k=>{ const namePadded = k.padEnd(maxName); const descPadded = (descs[k]||"(no description)").padEnd(maxDesc); console.log(`${namePadded} -> ${descPadded} -> ${pkg.scripts[k]}`); });'

scriptsDescriptions.scripts:list: Show all npm scripts with description and full command
